name: Personal Bank sends a live cooldown packet on use (#9582)
contract: Using the Personal Bank item (#9582: 'Icon does not enter cooldown animation') must, besides recording the ten-minute server-side cooldown, push a native SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN to the owning session right away, so the bank icon starts its cooldown swipe without a relog or any other packet that happens to rebuild the spellbook.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No cooldown packet has been sent for the bank spell yet
Let the vault summon land in the world
The server-side cooldown map holds the ten-minute cooldown
A live cooldown packet matching the ten-minute cooldown was sent to the session
